{{Short description|Concept in mathematics}}
In [[topology]], a branch of [[mathematics]], a '''topological monoid''' is a [[Monoid (category theory)|monoid object]] in the [[Category (mathematics)|category]] of [[topological space]]s. In other words, it is a monoid with a [[Topological space|topology]] with respect to which the monoid's binary operation is [[Continuous function (topology)|continuous]]. Every [[topological group]] is a topological monoid.
